## Description
Please describe your changes and the motivation behind them.

## Type of Change
- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change fixing an issue)
- [ ] New feature (non-breaking change adding functionality)
- [ ] Translation / i18n improvement
- [ ] Performance optimization or refactoring
- [ ] Documentation update

## Checklist
- [ ] My code follows the coding style and conventions of this project (PEP 8).
- [ ] I have verified that all unit tests pass (`python -m unittest discover -s tests`).
- [ ] I have verified that no credentials, tokens, or private keys are exposed or committed.
- [ ] If changing user-facing strings, all 4 languages (`lang/en.json`, `lang/tr.json`, `lang/ru.json`, `lang/de.json`) have been considered.
- [ ] Documentation (`README.md`, localized READMEs, and `CHANGELOG.md`) has been updated if applicable.
